summary: Avoid building five native attach indexes over claim history at store startup; attach lookups reuse the existing kind index

replay.detail: No claim replay or authority changes.

schema.detail: Store opening no longer creates the five native_attach_* indexes on claims. Existing indexes are left in place; kind-filtered attach lookups reuse existing claim indexes with JSON residual filters. No tables, schema versions or stored data change.

rules.detail: No rules or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Native attach admission and existing stores remain compatible.

downtime.detail: Avoids five full claim-history index builds during startup.

recovery.detail: No new rollback restrictions; existing attach indexes are not dropped.
